title: An always-on agent that has failed every single run still shows a green pulsing "Live" badge
whatYouSee: A client's scheduled agent card shows a green "Live" badge with a pulsing dot, "3 posts/week · 1 output each", and "Working toward Tue, Aug 4". Meanwhile the scheduler has refused that schedule on every attempt — out of credits, weekly cap reached, missing agent data, or the agent service not configured — and has produced nothing. Nothing appears in the recent-runs list either, because a refused attempt never creates a run. The client waits for content that will never arrive and has no way to learn why. Nobody at the agency sees it either.
whyItsWrong: The scheduler writes a human-readable refusal to the schedule row on every failed attempt, and its own comment says this is so "a schedule that can never fire is visible instead of silently green". Nothing renders it: the stored refusal appears in zero UI files. The page's row mapper drops the field, the row type has no slot for it, and the scheduler leaves the schedule's status "active" on refusal — so the card's only status source says active forever. And because the submit core deletes the job row when it refuses on credits, the failure leaves no trace in run history either.
evidence: src/app/api/run-scheduled/route.ts:23 — "visible instead of silently green" claim in the cron's own doc comment
src/app/api/run-scheduled/route.ts:85 — lastError written on every refused fire
src/app/api/run-scheduled/route.ts:92 — recurring runs only advance nextRunAt; status stays "active"
src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/agents/page.tsx:78 — toScheduleRows maps 8 fields, lastError/lastErrorAt not among them
src/components/custom-agents.tsx:72 — ClientAgentScheduleRow has no error field
src/components/custom-agents.tsx:504 — "Live" badge keyed only on schedule?.status === "active" (line 502)
src/components/custom-agents.tsx:541 — "Working toward {date}" shown whenever status is active
src/lib/jobs/submit-custom.ts:235 — job row deleted on a credit refusal, so no failed run shows in history
fix: Add `lastError?: string | null; lastErrorAt?: number | null` to ClientAgentScheduleRow (src/components/custom-agents.tsx:72) and pass both through toScheduleRows (src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/agents/page.tsx:78-88 — the source PlannedScheduledRun already carries them, see src/lib/types.ts:529-531). In the card: when lastError is set, replace the success "Live" Badge at custom-agents.tsx:502-505 with a `tone="warning"` "Needs attention" badge, and replace the "Working toward …" line at 541 with the stored refusal sentence plus the matching action (the existing AgentDataButton when it is a setup refusal, otherwise the ContactUsButton support flow). Surface the same two fields on the admin card in src/components/scheduled-runs.tsx (ScheduledRunsCard, rendered at src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/settings/page.tsx:139) so staff see it too.

title: A client who hits their spend cap gets a greyed-out Run button, no explanation, and advice that would not help
surface: Client AI Agents page, /clients/[id]/agents — agent card "Run now"
whatYouSee: "Run now" is grey and unclickable. Hovering it produces nothing at all — not even a tooltip. The only clues on the page are a small badge reading "0 credits available" and the line "25 credits per output". The client cannot tell whether they are out of credits, capped for the week, capped for the month, or when any of it resets.
whyItsWrong: Two compounding defects. First, the reason is delivered only as a hover tooltip on a disabled button, and the shared button primitive disables pointer events when disabled, so the browser can never show it — the explanation is unreachable by design. Second, the one message that exists ("Not enough credits. Ask your Karos team for a top-up.") is wrong for two of the three ways spending is blocked: a weekly or monthly cap is not fixed by a top-up, and the correct guidance — resets Monday, resets on the 1st, or ask to raise the limit — exists only in the denial text that appears after an action has already failed, never before.
evidence: src/components/custom-agents.tsx:555 — disabled={short} on the Run button
src/components/custom-agents.tsx:556 — title="Not enough credits. Ask your Karos team for a top-up."
src/components/ui.tsx:38 — Button sets disabled:pointer-events-none, so a disabled button never receives hover
src/components/custom-agents.tsx:475 — `short` derived from availableCredits alone; which of the three limits bound is discarded
src/components/custom-agents.tsx:466 — the badge is the only visible signal: "{availableCredits} credits available"
src/lib/credits.ts:263 — "It resets on Monday - or ask your Karos team to raise the limit" (post-failure only)
src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/agents/page.tsx:207 — the page hands down only the clipped number
fix: In src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/agents/page.tsx:207, alongside `availableCredits(credits)` compute which limit binds (compare credits.balance, weeklyLimit − weekSpent, monthlyLimit − monthSpent — the same three terms as availableCredits in src/lib/credits.ts:324-329) and pass a `blockReason` string down to ClientCustomAgents. In src/components/custom-agents.tsx delete the title attribute at line 556 and render that reason as a visible line under the button row (near the "{cost} credits per output" line at 552), worded per case: "Weekly limit reached — resets Monday" / "Monthly limit reached — resets on the 1st" / "Not enough credits". Add the existing ContactUsButton (variant="row", already used at src/components/client-rail.tsx:301) next to it — it needs userName/userEmail, so thread those from the page. Team decision on the 27 Jul call supersedes the softer fix: remove Perplexity and Copilot from the client report entirely — the capture-strip chips, both UnmeasuredEngineCard tiles, and the "Want Perplexity or Copilot coverage?" banner. Keep the internal 5-engine roster so they can return when connectors exist; just filter status "not-wired" out of every client-facing list.

title: The Reddit agent's schedule dialog offers up to 35 replies a week and bills for them — the product rule is one reply per run, five a week
surface: AI Agents (/clients/<id>/agents) → "Set schedule" on the Reddit agent
whatYouSee: The dialog is the same one every agent gets: "Posts per week" one to seven, "Outputs per run" one to five, and a cost line reading seven runs times five outputs times the per-output price. For a Reddit agent that is an offer of thirty-five drafted replies a week, called "posts", from a product that never posts.
whyItsWrong: The Reddit contract is explicit and load-bearing: one listing pull, one thread, one drafted reply per run, five a week maximum, and a run that burns a big budget is a build failure. When outputs per run is above one the scheduler prepends an instruction demanding exactly that many distinct outputs and charges the client that multiple on every fire — so the portal sells and bills a shape the agent is instructed never to produce. The word "posts" is also wrong for a draft-only product where a person posts every reply by hand.
fix: Make AgentScheduleModal (src/components/custom-agents.tsx:663) cadence-aware: when isRedditAgentIdentity(agent.key) (already imported from src/lib/custom-agent-launch.ts) pin outputsPerRun to 1 and hide the selector at 754-765, cap the postsPerWeek options at 5 (741-753), and relabel "Posts per week" → "Replies drafted per week" plus the modal description at 738 so it says a person posts each reply. Enforce the same caps server-side in configureClientAgentScheduleAction where the clamps live (src/lib/actions/planned-run-actions.ts:167-168, currently 1-7 and 1-10) so a stale page or a direct call cannot exceed them.

title: The agent intake pages tell clients to pick, edit and skip drafts "in your Workspace archive" — that screen has none of those controls
surface: X / LinkedIn / Reddit agent data → Feedback card; then Workspace → Archive
whatYouSee: The Feedback card tells the client: "Picking, editing, or skipping individual drafts happens on the drafts themselves, in your Workspace archive." The Reddit version says saying whether you posted an individual reply happens on the reply itself, in the Workspace archive, "and that is the signal that sharpens the voice fastest". In the Workspace archive the draft opens a read-only panel with a Copy button and "Mark as posted" — no pick, no edit, no skip, and no per-reply posted flag.
whyItsWrong: Those per-draft controls live in the three drafts-review components, which are mounted only inside the staff asset card, on staff-only routes that redirect clients away. The client's archive is documented as read-only. So the intake copy sends the client to a screen that structurally cannot do what it says — and the per-draft signal the Reddit copy calls the fastest way to sharpen the agent's voice can never be given by the client at all.
evidence: src/components/x-agent-intake.tsx:671-673 — "Picking, editing, or skipping individual drafts happens on the drafts themselves, in your Workspace archive."

src/components/reddit-agent-intake.tsx:298-300 — "Saying whether you posted an individual reply happens on the reply itself, in your Workspace archive, and that is the signal that sharpens the voice fastest."
src/components/asset-card.tsx:715,734,752 — LiDraftsBatch / RedditDraftsBatch / XDraftsBatch mounted only here
src/components/assets-view.tsx:113 and src/app/(app)/jobs/[id]/page.tsx:61 — the only two AssetCard call sites, both staff-only
src/components/archive-view.tsx:30 — "Read-only — review/approval stays on the staff Library"
src/components/asset-detail-modal.tsx:211,291 — the client's actual draft view: raw content plus "Mark as posted"
fix: Same root cause as the raw-text archive finding — fix them together. Mount the three DraftsBatch components in the client path by rendering them inside src/components/asset-detail-modal.tsx behind the parser check, passing clientId / jobId / assetId exactly as src/components/asset-card.tsx:715-757 does. If they must stay staff-only, rewrite the three Feedback paragraphs (x-agent-intake.tsx:671-673, linkedin-agent-intake.tsx:623-625, reddit-agent-intake.tsx:298-300) to stop promising controls the client does not have — for Reddit, either surface a per-reply posted control or drop the sentence that calls it the fastest signal.

title: The amber "3 ready" badge on an agent card never goes away, no matter how many times you review the drafts
whatYouSee: After the first successful run, each agent card grows an amber bell pill reading "1 ready" or "3 ready". You click it, read and approve everything. Come back and it still says "3 ready". It will say that forever, and the count only ever grows as more runs land.
whyItsWrong: The pill counts runs whose status is still "in review". Nothing in the codebase ever moves a run out of that status — approving a deliverable writes the deliverable, not the run — so the badge is permanently stuck on, which trains everyone to ignore the one new-work signal the client has. It also means the "Approved" and "Delivered" entries in the run status badge are unreachable states.
fix: Close the loop in approveAssetAction (src/lib/actions/asset-actions.ts:127-135): after the asset patch, load the producing job via asset.jobId and, once every job.assetIds asset is approved, updateJob(jobId, { status: "approved" }) using the existing updateJob helper in src/lib/data.ts:405. Alternatively compute the pill in src/components/custom-agents.tsx:477-480 from unapproved asset counts rather than job status — but then also delete the approved/delivered rows from the MAP in src/components/job-status.tsx:4-10, since nothing would ever reach them.

title: A run you cancelled on purpose comes back as a red "Failed", and a client cannot cancel at all
surface: Job detail (/jobs/<id>) and the run rows on AI Agents
whatYouSee: Staff press Cancel on a running agent. The page adds a "Cancellation requested" line and keeps saying Running. Minutes later it flips to a red Failed badge with the error "Job cancelled", and the progress strip shows "Run failed" pinned to the working step. A client who has just fired a twenty-five-minute billable run has no cancel control anywhere — the button exists only on the staff-only run detail page.
whyItsWrong: There is no cancelled state: the delivery handler folds cancelled onto failed and the status badge has no cancelled entry, so a deliberate stop is presented as a breakage. That pollutes failure counts and leaves staff unsure whether the cancel worked. Separately, a client who mis-fires a paid run cannot stop it and cannot reach the only page that could.
fix: Add "cancelled" to JobStatus (src/lib/types.ts:197-203); split it out of STATUS_MAP in src/app/api/agent-service/webhook/route.ts:34-39 so cancelled maps to itself while failed/dead_letter stay failed; give it a neutral tone and "Cancelled" label in the MAP in src/components/job-status.tsx:4-10; and handle it in src/components/managed-job-progress.tsx:15-19 so the strip does not read "Run failed". Then expose a client-safe cancel on the in-flight run row in src/components/custom-agents.tsx (584-634) backed by a client-authorized wrapper around cancelAgentServiceJob — cancelManagedJobAction is requireStaff today. The refund is already handled: refundJobCharge runs for every non-done outcome (webhook/route.ts:196-205).

title: After a client presses Run, the page never updates again — no progress, no completion signal
whatYouSee: You press Start run and get a green tick: the agent is working, usually ten to twenty minutes, and deliverables will appear in your Workspace archive once your Karos team approves them. You close the dialog. The run shows in "Recent agent runs" as Queued. Twenty minutes later it still says Queued. Nothing on the page moves and there is no link on the row to follow. Reloading the browser is the only way to see it change.
whyItsWrong: The auto-refresh component and the three-step Queued → Agent working → Ready strip both exist, but they are mounted only on the staff-only run detail page. The client's agents page has no auto-refresh, and client run rows deliberately carry no link, so there is nowhere to go and watch either. A ten-to-twenty-minute wait with a row frozen on "Queued" reads as a stuck run.
fix: In src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/agents/page.tsx render <AutoRefresh /> (src/components/auto-refresh.tsx) in the client branch whenever any row returned by toRunRows has status queued or running. Then reuse <ManagedJobProgress status={run.status} /> (src/components/managed-job-progress.tsx) on the in-flight row inside the "Recent agent runs" list at src/components/custom-agents.tsx:584-634 so the client sees Queued → Agent working → Ready for review. Finding #2 must land first for the "N ready" pill to be a trustworthy arrival signal.

title: Dialogs cap at 720 pixels tall with one scroll box and no fixed action bar, so Start run scrolls out of sight on the long agent briefs
surface: Run agent dialog; X, LinkedIn and Reddit agent data dialogs
whatYouSee: Open Run now on the X agent. The dialog is 720 pixels tall no matter how large the display. Inside it: title, description, an agent-data button, an intro card of deliverables, a client picker, a row of starting-point chips, the brief fields, the attachments picker, then the cost estimate and Start run. On the agent-data pane it is a company form, a card per seat, an add-a-seat button, a news box and a feedback box. The primary button shares one scroll box with the title, so it is off screen for most of the interaction and there is no bar pinned to the bottom.
whyItsWrong: The dialog hard-codes its height cap and puts title, description, body and actions all inside a single scrolling area, so long forms hide their own submit button and the caller has to reset scroll position by hand every time it swaps panes. On a tall display the dialog leaves hundreds of pixels of available height unused for no reason.
fix: Restructure src/components/modal.tsx into three flex rows inside the panel: a `shrink-0` header holding title, description and the close button (currently 87-96), a `min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto` body that keeps the existing scrollRef target (94), and an optional `shrink-0 border-t` footer fed by a new `footer?: ReactNode` prop. Raise the cap at line 81 to `max-h-[calc(100dvh-3rem)]`. Then move the estimate-plus-Start-run row from src/components/custom-agents.tsx:1249-1258 and the intake pane's Close row from 1075-1079 into that footer, so the primary action is always visible and the manual `scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({top: 0})` at line 933 can go.

title: Every agent deliverable is titled "<Agent name> - <Client name>" — the client sees their own company name bolted onto each item
surface: Workspace → Archive, staff Assets library, job detail — titles of anything an agent produces
whatYouSee: Items come out named "Reddit Agent - Acme Corp", "Blog article - Acme Corp", "Karos LinkedIn Company - Acme Corp". In a client's own workspace, where every single item belongs to them, half of every title is their own name.
whyItsWrong: The delivery handler deliberately strips the appended client name so the item is titled just the agent name, and its comment states the format it expects. But it looks for a long dash while all three submit paths write a plain hyphen, so the strip never fires — for any run, from any path. A one-character mismatch, affecting every deliverable.
fix: Export one shared separator constant (e.g. JOB_TITLE_CLIENT_SEPARATOR = " - " from a small shared module) and use it in all four places: the three title builders (src/lib/jobs/submit-custom.ts:207, src/lib/jobs/submit-managed.ts:108, src/lib/agent-service/run-custom-agent.ts:153) and the strip at src/app/api/agent-service/webhook/route.ts:323, replacing the em dash. Fix the stale comment at 319-321 too. Existing asset titles need a one-off backfill or they stay wrong.

title: If the agent service is unconfigured, a client's agents silently vanish behind "No active agents yet"
whatYouSee: A client who has three granted agents, live schedules and a run history opens AI Agents and sees an empty box: "No active agents yet — After your Karos team completes the first agent run, that agent will appear here." Their agents, their schedules and their run history are all gone from the page.
whyItsWrong: The empty state is chosen when either the client has no agents or the agent service settings are missing, and the copy only describes the first case. An outage or a bad deploy therefore reads to the client as "you were never set up", contradicting runs they have already received. Staff get an honest "Agent service not configured" message for the very same condition further down the same file, so the correct copy already exists.
fix: Split the condition at src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/agents/page.tsx:219. Keep the current EmptyState only for agents.length === 0. When agents.length > 0 but !agentServiceConfigured, either render <ClientCustomAgents> as normal (the Run button already refuses gracefully) or show a distinct EmptyState whose copy says agent runs are temporarily unavailable and the Karos team has been notified — do not reuse the never-set-up wording.

title: On the staff Agents page you can only discover an agent's client binding and its missing setup by firing a run and reading the error
whatYouSee: The staff Agents page lists every custom agent, including per-client instances whose card gives no hint which client they belong to. You press Run, the client picker defaults to the first client in the list, you fill in the brief, press Start run — and get a paragraph explaining the agent only runs for one specific client. Same for the X, LinkedIn and Reddit agents: no agent-data button, no setup warning, just a refusal after the brief is written. The offered link navigates away and takes the brief with it.
whyItsWrong: A client's own AI Agents page filters mismatched instances off the list and shows an agent-data button with an inline setup pane, so both gates are visible before anyone types. The staff hub passes neither the setup payloads nor a filtered client list to the same dialog, so both gates can only fire after submission. The refusal does offer a way to the setup, but on this page it is a plain link that discards the brief instead of the in-dialog pane switch the client page uses.
fix: In CustomAgentsHub (src/components/custom-agents.tsx:247): compute perClientAgentSlug(agent.key) per card and, when set, show the bound client's name on the card and pass only clients matching agentKeyMatchesClientSlug into RunCustomAgentModal at 365-372 (disable Run when no eligible client remains) — both helpers are already exported from src/lib/custom-agent-launch.ts:814-835. For the three intake-driven agents, either fetch the setups for the selected client in src/app/(app)/agents/page.tsx and pass xSetup/linkedinSetup/redditSetup through the hub so the dialog gets its data pane, or badge those cards "Set up on the client's AI Agents page" so the gate is visible before the brief is written.

title: Pressing "Start run" on the LinkedIn or Reddit agent without typing anything is refused — even though the only field is labelled optional
surface: AI Agents (/clients/<id>/agents) → run dialog for the LinkedIn and Reddit agents
whatYouSee: The Reddit run dialog has one box, "Anything to steer this run?", whose helper line reads "Optional. The agent picks the thread from the stored Reddit agent data either way." You leave it empty as instructed and press Start run. Red text: "Complete the brief before starting the run." Nothing on the form is marked required, so there is no way to tell what to complete. Same on LinkedIn. Clicking one of the suggestion chips above the box does get you moving, but nothing says that is what the error means.
whyItsWrong: The dialog builds the brief by joining only the non-empty fields and then refuses an empty result, so an agent whose single field is optional can never be run with the form left alone — which is the run these two agents are documented to support. The X agent escapes it only because its scope dropdown carries a default value. The error message also names a requirement that does not exist.
fix: In submit() at src/components/custom-agents.tsx:966-969, when buildCustomAgentPrompt returns empty and profile.fields contains no required field, fall back to a default instruction instead of erroring — the cleanest source is profile.quickStarts[0] (already rendered as the chips at 1142-1161). Keep the existing error only when a required field is genuinely blank. The server core rejects an empty prompt too (src/lib/jobs/submit-custom.ts:117-118), so build the fallback client-side rather than relaxing that guard. Optionally give the two profiles a defaultValue in src/lib/custom-agent-launch.ts (243-251, 380-388), the same trick the X profile uses at 336-346.

title: Staff cross-client lists render every row in the database with no search, filter, sort or paging, and no loading feedback
whatYouSee: The Jobs page is one flat list of every agent run that has ever happened across every client — agent name, client, relative time, status. No status tabs, no client filter, no search, no paging. The Clients page is a three-across grid of every client with no search and no sort, even though the client picker in the rail right next to it does have a search box. Clicking either nav item leaves the previous page frozen on screen with no feedback while the server reads.
whyItsWrong: Both pages read the entire collection and then render every row. Jobs is the page staff use most and the hardest to use at agency scale. Clients additionally reads every deliverable and every run in the database just to print two counts per card. Neither route has a loading placeholder, so the framework holds the old page in place for the whole round trip — only three of twenty-nine routes have one, and the heaviest three are not among them.
fix: For /jobs: move the list into a client component with a filter strip modelled on src/components/assets-view.tsx:69-91 — a status select over JobStatusBadge's states, a client select built from the `clients` array the page already loads at line 14, a search over agentName plus title — then `slice(0, 50)` with a "Load 50 more" button. For /clients: add a search input and a sort select (name / most recent run / most deliverables) above the grid at src/components/clients-grid.tsx:366, and replace the `listAssets()` / `listJobs()` full scans at src/app/(app)/clients/page.tsx:11 with per-client counts. Add `loading.tsx` files re-exporting the same skeleton used by src/app/(app)/assets/loading.tsx to /jobs, /clients, /admin/analytics, /clients/[id]/settings and /clients/[id]/agents.

title: The Agents hub offers agent-and-client pairings the server is guaranteed to refuse, after the whole brief has been typed
surface: Agents (/agents) → a per-client agent instance → Run
whatYouSee: Staff open the Agents page, see every custom agent including the per-client instances, click Run, get a dialog whose client dropdown lists every active client, fill in the brief and attachments, press Start run — and get told the agent runs only for the client whose lab slug matches, and that this client's slug is a different one. Nothing has run. The typing survives, but the trip was wasted.
whyItsWrong: The hub hands the unfiltered client list straight to the run dialog, and the dropdown never consults the agent's binding. The predicate that decides the outcome is applied on the per-client agents page but not here — and its own docstring claims the opposite, that both the list and the server refusal read the one predicate so a card is never offered that the server would reject. With an instance per client, most offered combinations are dead.
fix: Widen the clients prop: change src/app/(app)/agents/page.tsx:59 to pass `agentsRepoSlug` alongside id and name, and widen the type at src/components/custom-agents.tsx:255 to match. Then at the point the dialog is opened (custom-agents.tsx:365-372) pass only `clients.filter(c => agentKeyMatchesClientSlug(agent.key, c.agentsRepoSlug))` — the same predicate the per-client page uses at src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/agents/page.tsx:248 and the submit core enforces at src/lib/jobs/submit-custom.ts:110. When exactly one client is eligible, drop the dropdown at 1122-1140 and show the name as a fixed chip; when none are, disable the card's Run button with a title explaining the instance is bound to a client whose lab slug is not set, rather than opening a dialog that cannot succeed.

title: The four managed lab products (Social, Newsletter, Blog, Landing page) cannot be run from anywhere in the app
surface: Client AI Agents (/clients/[id]/agents) — and every surface that names them
whatYouSee: The AI Agents page shows only the custom agents (X / LinkedIn / Reddit instances). There is no card, no run dialog and no entry point for Social posts, Newsletter issue, Blog article or Landing page — even though all four are fully described in the product catalog with taglines, deliverables, time estimates and complete brief forms.
whyItsWrong: The section that renders those four products, with its guided run dialog and its run history, exists and is finished — and nothing in the app imports it. A repo-wide search for it returns only its own definition. So the entire managed-product run path is unreachable from a browser, and every surface that promises those agents (the SEO/GEO fix chips, the Connect page's Instagram example) is promising a product with no front door.
evidence: src/components/managed-products.tsx:34 — `export function ManagedProducts({` ; a repo-wide grep for ManagedProducts / "managed-products" returns only this line
src/components/managed-products.tsx:452 — the only submitManagedJobAction call in any component
src/lib/agent-service/products.ts:40 — MANAGED_PRODUCTS, the four-product catalog with full briefFields
src/components/seo-geo/presenter.ts:721-726 — PRODUCT_AGENT_LABELS still names all four to clients
fix: Decide once and make it true everywhere. Either mount <ManagedProducts clientId contextItems jobs jobPreviews /> into src/app/(app)/clients/[id]/agents/page.tsx alongside ClientCustomAgents (the staff branch at line 299 already computes `jobPreviews` for exactly this component, which is strong evidence it was unmounted by accident) — note submitManagedJobAction is staff-only, so if it goes in the client branch at line 220 the action needs a client path. Or delete src/components/managed-products.tsx and strip the four names out of client-facing promises: PRODUCT_AGENT_LABELS in src/components/seo-geo/presenter.ts:721-726 and the Instagram walkthrough on src/app/(app)/connect/page.tsx:62-68.
